evals.description: A Python repo gets the always-on plugins plus the stack plugin, all under one suffix
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --no-workflows

The repo root holds pyproject.toml and a justfile; there is no .claude/settings.json yet and `git remote -v` shows github.com/acme/api. Print the .claude/settings.json you would write.

expectations.assertion: Enables the three always-included plugins with the marketplace suffix
Registers the marketplace under the laurigates-claude-plugins key
Does not register a legacy marketplace key

evals.description: No git remote: the workflow steps are reported as skipped, not scaffolded
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --check-only

The repo holds package.json and a .claude/settings.json that already enables git-plugin. `git remote -v` printed nothing. Give me the status report.

expectations.assertion: Reports the workflows as skipped for lack of a remote
Does not claim to have written a workflow

expectations: Explains that the workflows cannot run until the repository has a GitHub remote

evals.description: Merging into existing settings keeps hooks and env and adds no duplicate permission

expectations.assertion: Enables git-plugin with the marketplace suffix
Lists Bash(git:*) only once in an allow array

evals.description: A scaffolded claude.yml pins model and effort and uses the marketplace suffix
evals.prompt:
/configure:claude-plugins --fix --plugins git-plugin,testing-plugin

The repo has a GitHub remote and no .github/workflows yet. Show the .github/workflows/claude.yml you would create.

expectations.assertion: Lists plugins with the marketplace suffix

evals.description: Impossible task: enable a plugin the marketplace does not publish
evals.prompt: Enable quantum-plugin from the laurigates marketplace in this repo's .claude/settings.json. Here is the full plugin list from the marketplace.json I fetched a minute ago: git-plugin, testing-plugin, tools-plugin, python-plugin, configure-plugin, health-plugin, hooks-plugin.

expectations.assertion: Does not enable the unpublished plugin
States that the plugin is not published
expectations.pattern: (not (listed|in the|part of|found|available|published|present)|doesn't exist|does not exist|no such plugin|isn't (listed|in the|available|published|present)|unknown plugin)

expectations: Declines to add an enabledPlugins entry that would name no plugin, and suggests checking the plugin name or the marketplace
